issues.description: Output column set for Aufgabe 01 is inconsistent: problem_statement.md explicitly requires the query to return ID, Name, Art and URL for all Freibäder, but the solution (solution_repository/aufgabe01.sql) selects only name, art, url (ID is missing). This mismatch will confuse students about which columns they must produce and may cause automatic checks or tests to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the expected output consistent across artifacts. Either (A) update solution_repository/aufgabe01.sql to include the ID column (e.g. SELECT id, name, art, url FROM Schwimmbad WHERE art='Freibad') so it matches the problem statement, and ensure tests/templates accept that column order; or (B) if ID is not intended, update problem_statement.md and any tests to request only name, art and url. Apply the same change to the template and test definitions so students and the autograder see the same required columns.
